create.name: Swami Chidananda
create.bio:
Swami Chidananda is a monk in the Hari Bhakta Vedic lineage, initiated by his guru Paramahamsa Vishwananda, the founder of Bhakti Marga. Before taking monastic vows he worked in finance, on mergers and acquisitions in investment banking, and he often draws on that working life when he speaks about bringing spiritual practice into busy modern routines. His title of Swami marks his formal place within the order.

The heart of his teaching is bhakti, the path of devotion, which he presents less as a set of ideas than as a lived relationship with the Divine grounded in love. He teaches mantra chanting as a daily practice: members of his online community are given a personal mantra with an explanation of its meaning, short teaching videos, and the chance to chant with him live in a group chat when he is not travelling, as well as one-to-one guidance. On his podcast, Path of a Swami, he talks about meditation, devotion and the Bhagavad Gita. He also leads small pilgrimages, by application, to holy places in India such as the Himalayan north, combining temple visits with daily spiritual practice, and shares guided practices on Insight Timer.

courses.title: Spiritual Journey, Shared Together: Swami Chidananda's Patreon Community
courses.description: An online membership for learning a daily mantra chanting practice. Members receive teaching videos and a personal mantra with its meaning, can chant live with Swami in a private group chat, are included in monthly prayers and can ask for one-to-one guidance.

courses.title: 10-Day Journey to India's High North
courses.description: A ten-day pilgrimage with Swami Chidananda to sacred caves and temples of the Indian Himalaya, with daily spiritual practice along the way. Places are by application, and the cost is sent on request.

free_resources.title: Swami Chidananda on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Swami Chidananda's free Insight Timer page, where his talks, mantra chanting and guided practices can be played in the app or a web browser at no cost.

free_resources.title: Path of a Swami Podcast
free_resources.description: Swami Chidananda's free podcast of talks on devotion, meditation and yogic scripture, with episodes on the Bhagavad Gita.
